title: Pointed connected coverings are classified by subgroups of the fundamental group in homotopy type theory

difficulty_reason: The authors construct a connected covering as the pullback of a delooped subgroup inclusion along the Galois fibration, prove its fiber is the coset set and total space a connected homotopy quotient, and recover subgroup monomorphisms from the exact homotopy sequence. Mutual inverseness requires an explicit fiberwise map through truncation and a calculation of its inverse/contractible fiber. The complete author Galois and Lemma35 fiber constructions and all bearing diagrams remain, supporting H2 as one non-routine type-theoretic classification construction.
core_obligations: Retain pointed connected coverings, subgroup-as-injective-map definition, universe/truncation and group hypotheses exactly.
Retain complete both-direction constructions and inverse/fiberwise calculations with every original bearing pullback diagram and actual AppendixA Lemma35 proof.
Existing generated/presented-group delooping claims serve only as cited background, not new counted targets or substitute proofs.
